title: Cam Issue Entry
description: Schema for a single per-file issue managed by cam issue commands.

stage.description: Lifecycle stage: idea -> specified -> planned -> shipped.

status.description: open = active; abandoned = closed without shipping.

blockedBy.description: List of issue ids that block this issue.

wsjf.description: WSJF scoring (Weighted Shortest Job First). Populated in Epico B.

rank.description: Implementation priority rank. Lower is higher priority. Populated in Epico C.

spec.description: Structured specification artifact. Shape is defined by Epico B.

type.description: Optional PR-title/label signal. Defaults to feat on read when absent.
